clean.corrective_rule: Before opening containers, first survey all surfaces (countertops, sinkbasin, fridge) to locate the object to clean.

cool.root_cause: The agent visited many locations (countertops, sinkbasin, stoveburners) but never took a mug; it saw a cup at the sinkbasin but did not attempt to take it, and never went to the fridge to cool.

cool.corrective_rule: When the target object is not immediately visible, check all surfaces and receptacles systematically, and take any object matching the target name.
